blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. is back in Manila on Friday evening following a three-day trip to Shenzhen, China, for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) Economic Leaders’ Meeting in Shenzhen, China. The aircraft carrying the Philippine delegation landed at the Villamor Air Base in Pasay City at 6:01 p.m. In his arrival statement, Marcos enumerated the “concrete results” yielded from his three-day visit. “At the Apec Economic Leaders’ Meeting, I spoke for an open, fair, and rules-based trading system and shared the gains that have made the Philippines an upper-middle-income economy and given us the widest free trade network in […]...
